qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Massive residential scale (~540k units) provides in-house maintenance and procurement efficiencies, but pricing power is legally restricted by German statutory caps (Kappungsgrenze) and municipal rent tables (Mietspiegel). Multi-year unlevered ROIC is structurally locked at 2-3%, failing the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (G3 Moat & Pricing). Germany's largest residential landlord (~540k units) has multi-year ROIC structurally locked at 2-4%, failing the 12% hurdle. Top-line rent growth is legally constrained by municipal Mietspiegel and federal rent caps, preventing pricing power >= inflation.
qualitative.evidence: Vonovia's historical GAAP ROIC is 2-3% (turning negative in 2022-2023 due to property revaluation impairments). Organic like-for-like rental growth of 3.5-4.0% is capped by the statutory Kappungsgrenze and municipal rent tables. High debt burden (€40B+ net debt, net debt/EBITDA 15-17x) reflects heavy leverage required to compensate for low unlevered asset returns.
